status: as-built provisional foundation; artifact/native/UI integration remains unavailable
authority: Host-only interfaces below grant no guest, network, installation, native launch or delegation authority.

units.bytes: UTF-8 octets unless the value is a Buffer, then exact buffer octets
units.generation: positive safe integer; current generation is required by the new scoped reads
units.attempt: nonnegative cumulative native attempt count, not an attempt-local ordinal
units.seq: one-based global invocation arrival sequence within a generation
units.localCall: zero-based broker call ordinal within one evaluator scope; phase/log calls leave gaps in the invocation journal
units.childId: c_ plus one-based child-only ordinal; independent of global seq (agents can interleave)

exports.strictJSON: strictJSON(value,{code='COMPOSITION_INPUT',maxBytes=1048576,maxDepth=32}={}) -> detached JSON data; descriptor-first, rejects proxies/accessors/custom prototypes/sparse or named arrays/cycles/nonfinite numbers/functions/symbols/bigints/undefined; 200000 visited-node bound
exports.canonicalJSON: canonicalJSON(value) -> compact recursively key-sorted JSON string; array order retained; strict traversal, 32 MiB bound
exports.exact: exact(value,requiredKeys,optionalKeys=[],code='COMPOSITION_INPUT') -> value or fault; use strictJSON first at host input boundaries
exports.isId: 1..100 ASCII letters/digits/underscore/hyphen; case-insensitive prototype/constructor/__proto__ names refused
exports.isText: isText(value,maxUTF16Units) -> nonempty bounded string without NUL
exports.validateBlobRef: strict exact BlobRef -> copied BlobRef; store-specific byte limit is separate
exports.validatePath: portable NFC relative literal path, <=1000 UTF-8 bytes and UTF-16 units; no backslash, dot traversal, .git, Windows devices, shell metacharacters or ambiguous components
exports.validateWorkflowDeclarations: strict complete declaration array -> copied array; <=32 aliases, case aliases refused; schemas use existing compileSchema
exports.validateArtifactScope: strict <=65536-byte {schemaVersion:1,ownedPaths:string[1..256]} -> {scope,scopeHash}; disjoint portable files or terminal-slash prefixes, case aliases refused

refs.fixtureBoundary: Only unmanaged synthetic host fixtures have run:null. Public managed entrypoints resolve an actual RunRef; null is not accepted by validateRunRef/ChildRef/WorkerRef.

sharedValidation.guestBoundary: Separate QuickJS process only. Captured intrinsic descriptor-first serialization rejects getters/toJSON/custom arrays before execution of user serializers; guest Proxy construction is unavailable. No host guest evaluation.

rootContext.factoryOwner: engine/controller.mjs creates the live context after lease, authority, source and generation admission. Read helpers create separate read-only contexts. A module-private WeakSet brands contexts; assertRootContext(context) checks brand and assertOwner(). JSON and broker inputs cannot mint one.
rootContext.serialization: Never serialize, persist, pass to a guest, or construct from worker-provided JSON. Frozen host object; contained SQLite handle/state are controller-owned and mutable.

fields.db: node:sqlite DatabaseSync; controller-owned writable handle, or read-helper-owned readOnly handle
fields.run: RunRef; null only for unmanaged synthetic fixtures
fields.state: controller-owned current durable header object; includes script/meta/args/launch/authority/deadlines/admission projection; not a guest API
fields.sources: verified SourceCatalog, or null when composition is not enabled
fields.signal: AbortSignal for evaluator admission/children; Pause aborts evaluators while accepted native work drains; Stop also aborts native work
fields.assertOwner: () -> void; live controller verifies exact lease token and refuses retired writes
fields.transaction: (synchronousBody:()=>T) -> T; controller-owned SQLite transaction, nests by joining existing synchronous transaction; never return a Promise
fields.policyHash: Sha256|null; H(C({accessPolicyHash,capturePolicyHash,artifactScopeHash})); null only without saved access identity
fields.catalogHash: Sha256|null; admitted parent native capability catalog fingerprint, else explicit worker capability bundle fingerprint; distinct from SourceCatalog.catalogHash
fields.capabilitiesHash: Sha256|null = explicit worker capability bundle fingerprint
fields.authorityOwnedPaths: string[]|null; saved artifact scope ownership paths, not filesystem security isolation
fields.artifactProviders: null at this checkpoint; no passing artifact provider is installed
fields.resolveOriginalInput: async () -> {descriptor:InputDescriptor,record:LoadedInputs}; lazily obtains existing workspace-run original immutable capture, persists before writer creation, verifies loadInputs; ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE if none admitted
fields.resolveCapture: async ({worker:WorkerRef}) -> {worker:WorkerRef,record:full authoritative WorkerRecord,workspace:retained WorkspaceRecord}; checks current run/generation/attempt and verifyWorkspace; ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE without captured writer output
fields.readBlob: async ({reference:BlobRef}) -> Buffer; composition private store only, verifies regular single-link immutable content/size/hash
fields.writeBlob: async ({bytes:Buffer|Buffer-convertible}) -> BlobRef; synced content-addressed private composition store, <=32 MiB
fields.resolveNativeAssetReads: async (input) -> rejects ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE; native asset observation wiring is deliberately absent

InputDescriptor.version?: 2 for explicit policy capture; omitted by legacy describeInputs

LoadedInputs.policy?: version2 CapturePolicy from engine/workspace-policy.mjs; absent for legacy version1

captureTypes.WorkerRecord: full retained current worker row, including position/origin/key/prompt/options/status/cached and when observed attempts/workspace/evidence/result/resultHash/usage/activity. Do not infer a capture from filename or model prose.

WorkspaceRecord.resultTree?: Git tree hash; collected output only
WorkspaceRecord.missingProtectedPaths?: relative path[] for explicit collected capture
WorkspaceRecord.verification: Use engine/workspaces.mjs verifyWorkspace(record), never infer collection from optional field presence. No artifact Candidate/Stage/Snapshot schema is claimed.

transactionOwnership: One root SQLite connection, root lease and shared admission ledger own agent slots/starts/attempts. Children have no independent backend or budget authority.
Agent invocation intent + link + reserved physical slot + queued worker row publish in one synchronous transaction.
Terminal result bytes are synced first; worker terminal + invocation terminal + invocation-terminal event publish in one synchronous transaction.
Child invocation intent and instantiated step catalog publish before its evaluator process starts.

Later artifact providers must use context.transaction for their own domain rows and coordinate an integrated transaction with the core owner; they must not independently commit core invocations or hold SQLite transactions across await. No artifact stage transaction has been implemented.

hostExports.engine/composition.mjs:invokeChild: async ({context:RootContext,alias:string,args:JSONObject,parentSeq:null=default,origin:{kind:'guest'}=default}) -> {invocation:ChildRef,source:Sha256,value:JSONValue,cached:boolean}; only a registered live context works. Non-null parentSeq and artifact origin explicitly reject REFINEMENT_UNSUPPORTED.
hostExports.engine/composition.mjs:resolveChildWorke: async ({context:RootContext,child:ChildRef,localId:string}) -> {worker:WorkerRef,record:full WorkerRecord}; validates full invocation history and exact child/run/generation, resolves one actual child-local options.id, never a prompt citation
hostExports.engine/composition.mjs:createRefinementS: ({context:RootContext}) -> frozen host service object with exactly invokeChild,resolveChildWorker,resolveNativeAssetReads,reserveStage,releaseStage. First two accept the same input objects including the identical context; resolveNativeAssetReads delegates context; reserveStage/releaseStage currently reject REFINEMENT_UNSUPPORTED.
hostExports.engine/composition-store.mjs:contextRunR: async ({runDir,sessionId}) -> RunRef|null; validates managed runtime.json and filesystem data identity; null only when runtime.json is absent for unmanaged fixtures
hostExports.engine/composition-store.mjs:resolveComp: async ({dataDir,run:RunRef,sessionId}) -> verified saved owner; exact data/runtime/session binding
hostExports.engine/composition-store.mjs:readChildre: async ({runDir,run,generation,after=null,limit=50,child=null}) -> ChildPage or exact ChildState; recorded current generation required
hostExports.engine/composition-store.mjs:validateInv: async ({context,generation=context.generation}) -> {count,lastKey:Sha256|null}; validates complete selected history, links, source/ancestor/scope/worker identities, result blobs and reused record hash/result links before paging/replay

composition.artifactIntegrationHook: createRefinementServices({context}) and the branded RootContext are the concrete host seam for an artifact module authored with a context parameter. The live controller currently routes refineArtifact/inputSnapshot/reviewPacket to explicit unavailable faults, and artifactProviders is null. There is no enabled callback registration or absent-module import. Wiring a reviewed artifact factory into controller/context and its broker branch requires a subsequent core-owned integration change; artifact authors must not reach private closures or claim this hook already runs refinement.

guestAPI.workflow: await workflow(alias,argsObject) -> {invocation:ChildRef,source:Sha256,value:JSONValue,cached:boolean}; exact two arguments, alias must be retained declaration, args/result validated with existing engine/schema.mjs compileSchema
guestAPI.depth: depth1 child evaluators reject workflow and refineArtifact; root refineArtifact rejects REFINEMENT_UNSUPPORTED
guestAPI.agentOptions: stepId selects a declared local step; inputSnapshot/reviewPacket reject ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE before native dispatch; normal existing agent options/settings remain validated

composition.scheduling: One native backend and FIFO native permit pool C; separate FIFO child evaluator lifetime pool C, root excluded. Waiting live children retain permits until actual child process exit and accepted child-native promises settle. Both pools use saved concurrency 1..256; no native permit held merely to wait for a child. Root/children/append share existing lifetime slot/start/attempt ledger (maxAgents<=1000). Root aggregate composition broker limit 10000 calls/4096 pending per generation; <=1000 child invocations; <=2000 journal agent+child records. These are independent caps, not additions to native capacity.

entry.script: BlobRef of exact UTF-8 source bytes

sourceRetention.bounds: source <=1 MiB, aggregate source <=32 MiB, catalog <=4 MiB; regular single-link files and ancestors checked, no source links/case aliases; all declarations frozen before backend/fork on public starts; saved resume never rereads original source locations

revisionRequest.expectedGeneration: positive integer, must match observed saved generation
revisionRequest.replacements: 1..32 exact {alias,expectedSourceId,source}; replacement locator must agree with edited root declaration

sourceRetention.replay: Read/validate complete saved journal before new admission. Copy verified closed prefix in original global order without evaluator/native starts. A changed/failed invocation cuts the suffix, then repeatedly closes over interleaved ancestors; all later calls rerun. Explicit reconciled restart maps physical worker back to its parent invocation and invalidates that container and later effects. No-agent sources use the same invocation path. Root cached calls must consume exact links; changed/omitted prefix rejects COMPOSITION_REPLAY_CHANGED. New effects never bypass unconsumed root prefix.
sourceRetention.revisionAudit: source_revisions stores generation/request/new descriptor with monotonically allocated revision; it does not yet expose a reviewed affected-child preview API

invocationRecord.key: Sha256 hash chain including source/args/authority/catalog/effective settings
invocationRecord.previousKey: empty string for first, else prior global key
invocationRecord.sourceId: Sha256 for workflow, null for agent
invocationRecord.child: ChildRef for workflow, null for agent

ChildPage.nextCursor: Id|null; opaque p_offset_hash binds run/generation/source catalog/complete child identities

composition.readIntegrityBoundary: Full selected-generation invocation/source/ancestor/link/worker/result integrity is validated beyond the requested page. Reused-from rows are hash/key/status/result-linked; the reader does not recursively revalidate every unrelated prior-generation invocation. Context catalogHash can be null for a restricted run without an explicit bundle; no native catalog evidence is invented.

exports.readStepsAt: async ({runDir,run,generation,after=null,limit=50}) -> StepProjection; full retained source/catalog/worker associations validated before slicing
exports.readStepCatalogs: async ({dataDir,run,sessionId,generation}) -> full verified StepCatalog[]; one read-only SQLite snapshot, current generation, full source bindings/associations validated
exports.projectSteps: pure host projection from complete verified catalogs/workers/run/generation/available/accepting plus bounded after/limit; not a scheduling API

declaration.label: nonempty string <=500 UTF-16 units
declaration.dependsOn: distinct exact earlier-or-later declared IDs in same acyclic scope

worker?.id: Id; unique preset child/root-local agent id

steps.limits: <=256 declarations and <=262144 UTF-8 bytes per scope; <=4096 instantiated declarations per generation; IDs and worker presets reject case aliases. Display edges do not schedule agents; explicit agent dependsOn remains the independent execution graph.

StepCatalog.sourceId: exact root source hash or retained child sourceId

StepProjection.available: boolean; legacy missing capability remains false/unsupported
StepProjection.nextCursor: null|opaque canonical base64url cursor <=200 chars binding run/generation/full catalogs

coverage.dynamicWorkers: actual workers without a declared assignment
coverage.futureWorkers: unknown|executionClosed (only when available and additions closed)

StepNode.label: declared label
StepNode.displayBlockedBy: dependency StepRefs whose execution is not completed; does not schedule

steps.paging: default50, 1..100 items, whole response <=1 MiB; cursor conflicts require restart. Unassigned terminal declarations remain planned. No artifact acceptance or future dynamic completeness is inferred.

controls.admission: <=16384 request bytes; session/runtime/data binding before mutation. Same UUID/body lookup precedes generation/revision CAS; altered domain payload conflicts. <=256 outstanding controls shared with legacy mailbox; <=10000 retained domain receipts per run. Pause/Stop close shared append/guest admission in receipt transaction. Controller applies cancellation to exact active child and its actual workers; queued cancelled child never forks.
controls.legacy: Existing requestControl(runDir,{sessionId,generation,action,...,requestId?}) retains legacy receipt shape.
